description: Meta Ad Library API: Search Google advertisers. Verified advertisers of the Google Ads Transparency Center whose name matches `q`, with their advertiser ID (`AR...`), country and an estimate of their number of ads. Use the ID with Search Google ads. Price: 5 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

limit.description: Advertisers (max 10, one page of the source)

name: ads_google_advertisers_search
title: Search Google advertisers
